A group is the maximal contiguous balanced parenthesis span: it starts where depth goes from 0 to 1 and ends where depth returns to 0. Any parentheses nested inside that span belong to the same single group.

Each time depth returns to 0 marks the end of one group; the implementation immediately starts collecting a new group from the next character. So multiple depth-zero returns before the string ends simply produce multiple separate entries in the output list.
